posts.message: Oct 2026 - Troop 77 scouts and leaders representing the troop helping Pack 7 AOL scouts with skills and leading the bike rides. We appreciate you all going out to help and model Troop life.

Nov 2026 - Alafia State Park Cycling Campout.   We had 8 scouts (and 3 leaders) complete the 22mile mountain biking ride needed for the cycling merit badge!  The rest of the scouts spent their time on the more difficult trails.  Unfortunately we did have a crash and a scout with a broken arm.   We camped a few miles away at TLC Gypsy Haven Horse Farm.  As always, ended the campout with our multi-denominational chuch service.

Troop 77’s new website is live. Some work still to complete. But after a dead site for several years it’s nice to have one back up!

Www.BSATroop77.com

Three new Eagles in Troop 77!  
Adam A in late August, and Brent B and Brian P this week!

Congratulations to all of you!

Oct 2026 - Hidden Lake Aviation Campout.   We were supposed to fly with EAA, but Hurricane Isaias out in the gulf had other plans for us.  We still camped, but the rain bands and wind potential made flying not possible.  We ended up getting very little rain or wind, but most of the rain just missed us.    

We still did the Aviation Merit Badge, and will fly a different day.
Sept 2026 - Manatee Springs Campout.  Canoeing, Kayaking, Snorkeling, Campfire Program, Flag Retirement - It was a full weekend of fun in absolutley wonderfull weather.
